# Closure checklist
Load when: before setting an activity to done
Applies to: lpm-deliver-activity    Source: help articles
## Summary
Close only when every criterion has a test or evidence.
## Facts
| Field / value | Meaning | Consequence for the agent |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | activity state | `done` only after the checklist |
## Rules
1. A commit is evidence of work, not closure.
